# pve_node_disk_lvmthin (Data Source)

Looks up a single LVM thinpool on a Proxmox VE node (`GET /nodes/{node}/disks/lvmthin`, filtered by thinpool name).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_node_disk_lvmthin" "data" {
  node = "pve1"
  name = "data"
}

output "data_thinpool_used_bytes" {
  value = data.pve_node_disk_lvmthin.data.used
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Thinpool name (`lv` in the PVE listing).
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node to query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the node name.
- `lv_size` (Number) The size of the thinpool in bytes.
- `metadata_size` (Number) The size of the metadata LV in bytes.
- `metadata_used` (Number) The used bytes of the metadata LV.
- `used` (Number) The used bytes of the thinpool.
- `vg` (String) The associated volume group.
